en.text:
Using your Class Ability (even while the weapon is stowed) grants you 'Slice' for #e${8+#d} seconds.

While 'Slice' is active, damaging non-<strand/>Severed targets <strand/>Severs them, grants a stack of Slice, and refreshes the buff duration. (Hitting immune targets also triggers this.)

Reaching 5 stacks immediately removes the buff.

If the <strand/>Severing hit kills the target, the perk will not trigger and you will not gain a stack.

enhanced (
var d = 1
#e Buff duration is increased by 1 second.
